title: Byte Engine model import settings
description: Optional source-model settings for .fbx, .gltf, and .glb assets.

$schema.description: The local JSON Schema reference for this asset.

default_resource.description: The resource selected when the asset ID has no fragment.

skeleton.description: The canonical skeleton resource used to remap imported animation tracks by node name.

lods.description: Detail level generation for the model's meshes. Skinned primitives always keep full detail only.

enabled.description: Whether meshes get coarser detail levels. When false, the other keys have no effect.

max_levels.description: The most levels a primitive stores, counting full detail.

max_error.description: The largest error a level may carry, as a fraction of the primitive's largest extent.

lock_borders.description: Whether open borders keep their vertices. Set it when primitives that meet along a border show gaps at a distance.

asset.description: FBX material-name overrides. Use default for an unassigned material slot.
